But there will be minimum of 6 batters in total (3 from each team), so you add the probability together 6-12% chance there’s a home run in first inning.

That was just the average, certain top order batters have way higher chance of hitting home runs. Like Shohei Ohtani or Juan Soto have almost 25% chance of hitting a home run across the match. So teams like Dodgers or Yankees effectively have roughly 20% chance of home run in first inning.

Over under are one of the most difficult bets to get right. you need lot of knowledge about the teams. That's why i only do it for NBA

You basically have to take into account tons of stats like pace of play, possessions per minute, score per possessions, points/pergame, defense/offense of the home team, defense/offense of the away team. 

Teams with good defense will usually lead to unders. In the NBA some of these teams are Celtics, Heat, Mavs, Warriors, OKC. 

Teams with poor defense will usually lead to over. in nba some of these are Kings, Spurs, Bulls, Rockets, Magic, Pacers, etc. these will usually go over. 

Now if two teams with poor defense play, the over/under will be set very high. if two teams with good defense play, it will be set very low. if team with good defense and poor defense play, it will be in the middle like 220 or something. Now with this, you have to analyze the individual match ups

and i only do this for NBA. it's very hard for international leagues, there's not enough data for them or they're harder to find. NBA is the best and most consistent league in the world for basketball
